Each version below is a published PC printing; card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository. Every visibly different printing is a separate version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026); a later copy of the same image in another format is not (13 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' compared with the previous version (the high-resolution image of 20 February 2025; left = before, right = after): [[File:V11-L-jedilightsaber_ai-2026-01-20-vs-hires-2025-02-20-changes.png|frameless|upright=2]].

The earliest published image of this card: it was only ever committed as a high-resolution PNG, so version lists built from the card-size images missed it (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026).
